question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

He had _________ (Enough) time to finish the task.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Sufficient**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Enough**' is used to describe as much or as many as required. (पर्याप्त)

 
 
• **Example**: I have had **enough **of your complaints.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym here is '**sufficient**'. '**Sufficient**' means adequate for the purpose; enough. (पर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example**: The income from my part-time job is **sufficient **for my needs.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for '**Enough**' is '**Sufficient**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: '**Insufficient**' means not enough; inadequate. (अपर्याप्त). It is the antonym of 'enough', not a synonym.
 
• Option 3: '**Massive**' mainly refers to something that is very large and heavy. (विशाल). It is not synonymous with 'enough'.
 
• Option 4: '**Perpetual**' generally means never ending or changing, continuous. (नित्य). It is not synonymous with 'enough'.
